outcomes.single: one dominant bot signal routes to one mode
outcomes.orderedBundle: clearly separate bot intents route to an ordered mode list in tie-break order
outcomes.defer: a bot request that names no mode asks which mode the reader means

routerPolicy.defaultResourceContract: A scored route assembles exactly the selected mode's declared resources. defaultResource is consulted only when no mode scores, and then only as the defer-time suggestion offered alongside disambiguation. It is never added to a scored route's resource set.
routerPolicy.discoveryClassesContract: Classes listed here are hub discovery and defer evidence only. No mode's scoring classes reference them, so a prompt that matches only hub vocabulary scores zero modes and takes the defer outcome instead of fanning out to every mode.
routerPolicy.orderedKeywordContract: A keyword that starts with ~ lists whole words that must appear in the prompt in that order, each at most three words after the one before, so ~pause bot matches pause the triage bot but not pause the robot. A hyphenated name such as release-notes counts as one word, and so does a word with an apostrophe inside it, such as michel's; a possessive 's is dropped, so ~bot schedule matches the bot's schedule but not the robot's schedule. Every other keyword is a contiguous phrase. Ordered keywords count only when no contiguous keyword matched any mode, so they never change a decision a contiguous keyword produces. They also stay out of a prompt that holds a word from orderedKeywordBlockers, the words of a request to write a bot, so start writing the bot defers instead of reaching run. build is not listed, because the build bot names a bot, and neither are write and create, because run the triage bot to write a summary asks for a run.
